objective: Remove the complete nested application-data collection copy in dxfRW::writeAppData while preserving reference resolution order, callback timing, output semantics, and caller-owned source values.

behavior: Validates every input group before invoking the configured reference resolver.
Builds a pre-output ordered vector only for known reference handles that are replaced/omitted and known groups that become empty.
Emits all remaining groups and values by iterating the original const application-data structure.
With no resolver, creates no resolved nested-list copy and formats generic remapped handles only when their value changes.
Removes the former private resolveAppDataReferences() full-list materializer.
implementation.compatibility: No public class layout change. Resolver callbacks remain one-shot and all occur before application-data output.

covers: exact resolver callback counts and final mapped handles
zero-target reference removal and empty optional-group omission
foreign application groups and malformed opaque XDATA preservation
ordinary setHandleRemap behavior without a resolver
caller application-data source values remain unchanged
resolver exception, mutation refusal, and retry paths

limits: This verifies source-level removal of a full nested-list clone; it does not measure allocator capacity, peak RSS, or all writer allocations.
Other raw/typed carrier and projection copies remain separate scopes.
No full test suite, peer runtime, native CAD application, or fuzz campaign was run.
